narration.text: Imagine turning any story idea into a complete illustrated comic in just seconds.
You don't need any drawing talent because BoredComic writes the storyboard and generates every panel for you.
This AI agent creates multi-page illustrated comics with custom characters, consistent dialogue, and artwork across every single page.
Describe your characters and story, choose a plan, and BoredComic generates a full comic with storyboard, dialogue, and panel art.
Plans start at fifty cents for a short comic, and you can revise pages or register characters for continuity.
Visit OKX dot AI to try BoredComic now and bring your story ideas to life instantly with AI.
